top_signals.title: Tech Stocks Tumble With Nvidia Earnings, Anthropic IPO in Focus
top_signals.summary: US stocks extended their slump on Monday, led by technology shares, as investors remained skittish around the AI trade before Nvidia Corp. earnings and the expected initial public offering of Anthropic PBC this week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Trump says he's OK with Jensen Huang returning as Nvidia CEO, sees no national security risk
top_signals.summary: President Trump told reporters before departing for a trip to Asia that former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair did not put U.S. national security at risk.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Eurasian Resources Group to split its Kazakh and African assets
top_signals.summary: Deal will free up more highly prized African copper and cobalt operations from Kazakh state control
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: US and Russia to oppose talks on limiting autonomous weapons
top_signals.summary: Major arms producers the U.S. and Russia look set to oppose a push at a global meeting to launch negotiations on legally binding rules for autonomous weapons.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Upbit operator Dunamu posted a net loss of $13.8 million in Q3, swinging from $177 million in profit the same quarter last year.
